title: Every translated heterogeneous Gaussian mixture has an exact precision-Jensen Fisher sandwich

heterogeneous_mixture.law: Let nu=int N(m_z,S_z)pi(dz), with arbitrary positive covariances S_z, arbitrary cutoff-space means m_z and finite required moments.
heterogeneous_mixture.moments: Writing alpha=E m_z, C=Cov(m_z) and T=E S_z+C, the mixture mean is alpha and its covariance is T.
heterogeneous_mixture.convex_upper: Fisher convexity gives U=E[m_z^T Omega m_z+Tr Omega(S_z+S_z^(-1)-2I)] as an upper bound for I_Omega(nu|mu).
heterogeneous_mixture.moment_lower: K1533 gives L=alpha^T Omega alpha+Tr Omega(T+T^(-1)-2I) as a lower bound.
heterogeneous_mixture.exact_width: The mean-covariance terms cancel exactly, leaving U-L=Delta=Tr Omega(E S_z^(-1)-T^(-1)).
heterogeneous_mixture.positivity: Operator convexity gives E S_z^(-1)>=(E S_z)^(-1)>=T^(-1), so Delta is nonnegative.
heterogeneous_mixture.scope_guard: Delta is the exact sandwich width, not the exact mixture Fisher information. It can be order N^4 under order-one covariance or translation heterogeneity.
